title: Canonical internal-to-sectionwise total-complex comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site $J$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $B=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the abelian sheaf tensor [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. Write $B_{sec}$ for its section-ring sheaf, $\mathcal A$ for $B$-module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], $\mathcal M$ for sectionwise modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $F$ for the section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use its termwise extensions to cochains and ordinary derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], the relative tensor [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor], the derived tensor and its lax localization comparison [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], the fixed ringed-site derived Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and the explicit coefficient total tensor [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Define the concrete total comparison by transporting the canonical summand comparison of [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison] to the native internal cochain tensor and the coefficient sum total. The canonical comparison exists with its specified equation on every total summand; these equations uniquely determine its data. The two source total implementations are equal, as are the two target implementations, so the heterogeneous equality with that fixed summand comparison uniquely determines the transported isomorphism, for every pair of cochain complexes. The section-module category is Grothendieck abelian in coefficient universe $u+1$; its ordinary derived category uses that Hom universe. All ring, module-category, cochain, derived-functor and localization-factor aliases retain these canonical constructions.
